lead_raw_text:
The structure of U3Co12Pd6 (reduced formula UCo4Pd2) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 21 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Co and Pd centers each with eight geometric neighbors (Co–Co/Pd and Pd–Co, respectively), while U centers have 16 neighbors (8 Co and 8 Pd). Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner-sharing between Co and Pd 8-vertex polyhedra, and corner, edge, and face sharing among the Co polyhedra, forming a 3-dimensional connected network.
